issues.description: `Course.instructor` type is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and template define it as `String`, but the solution defines it as `[String]`. This also changes the `Course` initializer signature, so students following the stated API (`Course(name:instructor:ratings:)` with a `String` instructor) cannot match the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make `Course.instructor` consistently a `String` across problem statement, template, and solution (and update the solution initializer to `init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int])`). If multiple instructors are intended, update the problem statement and template to use `[String]` and adjust printing/formatting expectations accordingly.
